places.name: Binnenhof
places.ai_summary: A historic complex of buildings in the heart of The Hague, serving as the seat of the Dutch Parliament.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours available during working hours.

places.place_tip: Take a guided tour to learn about Dutch politics and history.

attribution.title: Den Haag Binnenhof 02
attribution.author: Zairon
attribution.description: Binnenhof, The Hague, Province of South Holland, Netherlands

places.name: Mauritshuis
places.ai_summary: A renowned art museum housing masterpieces like Vermeer’s 'Girl with a Pearl Earring' and works by Rembrandt.
places.place_tip: Book tickets online to skip the queue.

places.name: Peace Palace
places.ai_summary: An iconic building housing the International Court of Justice, symbolizing global peace and justice.
places.place_tip: Visit the Visitor Centre for insights into the history of the palace.

attribution.title: Friedenspalast Den Haag (100MP)
attribution.author: Thomas Wolf, www.foto-tw.de
attribution.description: Peace Palace, seat of the International Court of Justice in The Hague, Netherlands

places.name: Scheveningen Beach
places.ai_summary: A popular beach destination in The Hague, known for its long sandy beach and vibrant pier.

opening_hours.notes: Lifeguard service from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a walk on the beach promenade and visit the pier.

attribution.title: Den Haag Scheveningen Pier 32
attribution.author: Zairon
attribution.description: Pier of Scheveningen, The Hague, Province of South Holland, Netherlands

places.name: Madurodam
places.ai_summary: A miniature park showcasing Dutch landmarks and historical sites in a miniature format.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Don't forget to visit the miniature airport and the Dutch canals.
places.address: George Maduroplein 1, 2584 RZ The Hague, Netherlands

attribution.title: Madurodam main entrance
attribution.author: Gellerj
attribution.description: Madurodam miniature city in the Netherlands - main entrance.

places.name: Noordeinde Palace
places.ai_summary: The working palace of the Dutch royal family in The Hague, featuring a beautiful garden.

opening_hours.notes: Garden open to the public, palace interior not open for visits.

places.place_tip: Stroll through the garden and enjoy the view of the palace.

places.name: Escher in Het Paleis
places.ai_summary: A museum dedicated to the works of M.C. Escher, featuring his famous impossible constructions.
places.place_tip: Explore the interactive exhibits for a unique experience.
places.address: Lange Voorhout 74, 2514 EH The Hague, Netherlands

attribution.title: Gevel Escher in Het Paleis 300 dpi

attribution.description: Paleis het Lange Voorhout, sinds 2002 is hier Escher in Het Paleis gevestigd.

places.name: Panorama Mesdag
places.ai_summary: A cylindrical panorama painting by Hendrik Willem Mesdag, depicting the sea and dunes near Scheveningen.
places.place_tip: Visit the gift shop for unique souvenirs.

places.name: Lange Voorhout
places.ai_summary: A historic street in The Hague, known for its beautiful trees, monuments, and the annual Christmas market.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited on foot or by bike.

places.place_tip: Look out for the various art installations along the boulevard.
places.address: Lange Voorhout, 2514 EA The Hague, Netherlands

attribution.title: Lange voorhout
attribution.author: M.Minderhoud
attribution.description: Lange Voorhout , Den Haag, Netherlands, 21 oktober 2005

places.name: Gemeentemuseum
places.ai_summary: A major art museum in The Hague, featuring works by Dutch masters, modern art, and an extensive collection of applied arts.
places.place_tip: Check out the museum shop for unique gifts.

attribution.title: Gemeente museum
attribution.author: Roel Wijnants
attribution.description: Zicht op een deel van het Kunstmuseum Den Haag. Architect Berlage

places.name: Ridderzaal
places.ai_summary: The Hall of Knights, a medieval building in The Hague, used for official state occasions and events.
places.place_tip: Visit during a parliamentary recess for a quieter experience.

attribution.title: Den Haag Binnenhof Ridderzaal 4
attribution.author: Zairon
attribution.description: Knight's Hall of the Binnenhof, The Hague, Province of South Holland, Netherlands

places.name: Haagse Markt
places.ai_summary: The largest outdoor market in The Hague, offering a wide variety of goods, from fresh produce to clothing.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited on a Saturday for the full market experience.

places.place_tip: Try the local street food for a quick and tasty meal.

places.name: Kunstmuseum
places.ai_summary: An art museum in The Hague, focusing on modern and contemporary art, including works by Dutch and international artists.
places.place_tip: Check the museum's schedule for temporary exhibitions.

places.place_tip: Participate in a tea ceremony if available.

places.name: Museum Beelden aan Zee
places.ai_summary: An art museum located on the beach in Scheveningen, dedicated to modern and contemporary sculpture.
places.place_tip: Combine your visit with a walk on the beach.

places.name: The Pier Scheveningen
places.ai_summary: A famous pier in Scheveningen, featuring an observation wheel, restaurants, and shops.

opening_hours.notes: Opening hours may vary by season.

places.place_tip: Enjoy the view from the observation wheel.

places.name: Malieveld Park
places.ai_summary: A large public park in The Hague, popular for picnics, events, and outdoor activities.

opening_hours.notes: Check the park's calendar for events.

places.place_tip: Bring a picnic and enjoy the green space.

places.name: Prison Gate Museum
places.ai_summary: A museum located in a former prison, showcasing the history of crime and punishment in The Hague.
places.place_tip: Combine your visit with a walk in the nearby park.
places.address: Oude Molstraat 2, 2518 GG The Hague, Netherlands

places.name: Hofvijver
places.ai_summary: A picturesque pond in the center of The Hague, offering a scenic view of the Parliament buildings.

opening_hours.notes: Best viewed from the surrounding park.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera for stunning photos.

places.name: Kurhaus
places.ai_summary: A historic hotel and restaurant in Scheveningen, known for its grand architecture and seaside location.
places.place_tip: Try the seafood dishes, it's a local specialty.
